caption: The drawing features a single cylindrical container with a slightly flared rim, depicted standing upright on a plain background. The container is tan or light brown in color, with subtle shading indicating its curvature and giving it a three-dimensional appearance. Around the upper area of the container, near the rim, the word "PLUMBS" is written in large, bold, blue uppercase letters. Below the text, there is a blue decorative motif resembling a stylized fleur-de-lis or floral design. The container has no visible handles or lid, and its top is open, revealing a dark brown interior. The background is a light, solid color with no additional objects or details, and there is a small, faint signature in the lower right corner.
